numericObservation.source: Read-only audit parts.mount and sourceLandmarks; not inferred from screenshot pixels
numericObservation.frontGoggles: Compares shared mount to midpoint of the two observed pupil landmarks, not an independently measured center of each lens.
numericObservation.profileGoggles: LEFT near=left, RIGHT near=right after parent normalization.
numericObservation.mask: Compares actual source mount to observed/inferred mouth point.
numericObservation.back: No eye/mouth points; rear strap visual review only, no eye-contact equality claimed.

notAccepted: Actual NPC eyewear world4views not included in this report.

All anatomy loss/prosthetic/partially dressed/conditions and eyewear combinations.
Every individual lens optical center or3D contact, strap tension, eye protection or mask safety/function.
Whole-world save/time/RNG/Core acceptance or the other32diagnostic states.
visualLimits: 1x does not resolve every pupil/lens edge;2x/4x comparisons support the visual findings.
The supplied beard/stubble and image glints limit exact face-feature identification.
Eye/mouth source points retain their documented raw-pixel uncertainty.
